title: Akhand Ramayan Path
summary: The Ramayan Prachar Samiti, Mumbai, organised a two-day Akhand Ramayan Path from 19th to 20th October 2026, seeking the blessings of Lord Shri Ram.
description: The Ramayan Prachar Samiti, Mumbai, organised a two-day Akhand Ramayan Path from 19th to 20th October 2026, seeking the blessings of Lord Shri Ram. The programme featured the commencement of the Ramayan Path, Shri Ram Janm Mahotsav, Sundar Kand, Raj Tilak ceremony, concluding Aarti and Mahaprasad. Devotees gathered with their families to participate in this sacred occasion and experience the spiritual message of the Ramayan.
